svg.title: Blue on White
svg.desc: Interpretive hand-authored SVG. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. White rectangular painted support retained. Rounded blue upper mass, right-side notch and long lower hook transcribed from actual Smithsonian reference; fine contours and paint texture simplified. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://americanart.si.edu/artwork/blue-white-13463; inspected2026-10-27. Approximation, not a facsimile.
